verses.literal: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet according to Shigionoth

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֮ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְךָ֙ בְּקֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּרֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šā·ma‘·tî šim·‘ă·ḵā yā·rê·ṯî Yah·weh pā·‘ā·lə·ḵā bə·qe·reḇ šā·nîm ḥay·yê·hū bə·qe·reḇ šā·nîm tō·w·ḏî·a‘ bə·rō·ḡez ra·ḥêm tiz·kō·wr
verses.literal: O LORD I have heard the report of You I stand in awe O LORD of Your deeds Revive them in these years make them known in these years In Your wrath remember mercy

verses.original: אֱל֙וֹהַ֙ מִתֵּימָ֣ן יָב֔וֹא וְקָד֥וֹשׁ מֵֽהַר־ פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ הוֹד֔וֹ וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾɛ̆·lō·ha mit·tê·mān yā·ḇō·w wə·qā·ḏō·wōš mê·har- pā·rān se·lāh kis·sāh šā·ma·yim hō·w·ḏōw ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯōw mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: God came from Teman and the Holy One from Mount Paran Selah His glory covered the heavens and His praise filled the earth

verses.original: וְנֹ֙גַהּ֙ כָּא֣וֹר תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה קַרְנַ֥יִם מִיָּד֖וֹ ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם חֶבְי֥וֹן עֻזֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·ḡah kā·’ō·wr tih·yeh qar·na·yim mî·yā·ḏōw lōw wə·šām ḥeḇ·yō·wn ʿuz·zōh
verses.literal: His radiance was like the sunlight rays flashed from His hand where His power is hidden

verses.original: לְפָנָ֖יו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְיֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nāw yê·leḵ dā·ḇer wə·yê·ṣê re·šep̄ lə·raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: Plague went before Him and fever followed in His steps

verses.original: עָמַ֣ד׀ וַיְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַיַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ הַרְרֵי־ עַ֔ד שַׁח֖וּ גִּבְע֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·maḏ way·mō·ḏeḏ ’e·reṣ rā·’āh way·yat·têr gō·w·yim way·yiṯ·pō·ṣə·ṣū har·rê- ‘aḏ ša·ḥū giḇ·‘ō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām hă·lî·ḵō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām lōw
verses.literal: He stood and measured the earth He looked and startled the nations the ancient mountains crumbled the perpetual hills collapsed His ways are everlasting

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן רָאִ֖יתִי אָהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן יִרְגְּז֕וּן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·wen rā·’î·ṯî ’ā·ho·lê ḵū·šān yir·gə·zūn yə·rî·‘ō·wṯ ’e·reṣ miḏ·yān
verses.literal: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress the curtains of Midian were trembling

verses.original: הֲבִנְהָרִים֙ חָרָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אִ֤ם בַּנְּהָרִים֙ אַפֶּ֔ךָ אִם־ בַּיָּ֖ם עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל־ סוּסֶ֔יךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖יךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḇin·hā·rîm ḥā·rāh Yah·weh ’im ban·nə·hā·rîm ’ap·pe·ḵā ’im- bay·yām ‘eḇ·rā·ṯe·ḵā kî ṯir·kaḇ ‘al- sū·se·ḵā mar·kə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā yə·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: Were You angry at the rivers O LORD Was Your wrath . . . against the streams Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses on Your chariots of salvation

verses.original: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת אֹ֣מֶר סֶ֑לָה נְהָר֖וֹת תְּבַקַּע־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘er·yāh ṯê·‘ō·wr qaš·te·ḵā šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ō·mer se·lāh nə·hā·rō·wṯ tə·ḇaq·qa‘- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You brandished . . . Your bow You called for . . . many arrows Selah You split the earth with rivers

verses.original: רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֙ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥יהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ū·ḵā yā·ḥî·lū hā·rîm ze·rem ma·yim ‘ā·ḇār nā·ṯan tə·hō·wm qō·w·lōw rō·wm yā·ḏê·hū nā·śā
verses.literal: The mountains saw You and quaked torrents of water swept by The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר חִצֶּ֙יךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: še·meš yā·rê·aḥ ‘ā·maḏ zə·ḇu·lāh lə·’ō·wr ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā yə·hal·lê·ḵū lə·nō·ḡah bə·raq ḥă·nî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows at the brightness of Your shining spear

verses.original: בְּזַ֖עַם תִּצְעַד־ אָ֑רֶץ בְּאַ֖ף תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.literal: You marched across the earth with fury You threshed the nations in wrath

verses.original: יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־ מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־ צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: yā·ṣā·ṯā lə·yê·ša‘ ‘am·me·ḵā lə·yê·ša‘ ’eṯ- mə·šî·ḥe·ḵā mā·ḥaṣ·tā rōš mib·bêṯ rā·šā‘ ‘ā·rō·wṯ yə·sō·wḏ ‘aḏ- ṣaw·wār se·lāh
verses.literal: You went forth for the salvation of Your people to save Your anointed You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe Selah

verses.original: נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְמַטָּיו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פְּרָזוֹ יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: nā·qaḇ·tā ḇə·maṭ·ṭāw rōš pə·rå̄·zō yis·‘ă·rū la·hă·p̄î·ṣê·nî ‘ă·lî·ṣu·ṯām kə·mōw- le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘ā·nî bam·mis·tār
verses.literal: With his own spear You pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak

verses.original: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dā·raḵ·tā ḇay·yām sū·se·ḵā ḥō·mer ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: You trampled the sea with Your horses churning the great waters

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י לְקוֹל֙ צָלֲל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּעֲצָמַ֖י וְתַחְתַּ֣י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֙וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî wat·tir·gaz biṭ·nî lə·qō·wl ṣā·lă·lū śə·p̄ā·ṯay yā·ḇō·w rā·qāḇ ba·‘ă·ṣā·may wə·ṯaḥ·tay ’er·gāz ’ă·šer ’ā·nū·aḥ lə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh la·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·‘am yə·ḡū·ḏen·nū
verses.literal: I heard and trembled within my lips quivered at the sound Decay entered my bones I trembled where I stood Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־ תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה־ זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־ עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·’ê·nāh lō- ṯip̄·rāḥ wə·’ên yə·ḇūl bag·gə·p̄ā·nîm ki·ḥêš ma·‘ă·śêh- za·yiṯ ū·šə·ḏê·mō·wṯ lō- ‘ā·śāh ’ō·ḵel gā·zar mim·miḵ·lāh ṣōn wə·’ên bā·qār bā·rə·p̄ā·ṯîm
verses.literal: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.literal: yet I will exult in the LORD I will rejoice in the God of my salvation

verses.original: יְהוִ֤הּ אֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּֽאַיָּל֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·šēm ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥê·lî way·yā·śem raḡ·lay kā·’ay·yā·lō·wṯ wə·‘al bā·mō·w·ṯay yaḏ·ri·ḵê·nî lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: GOD the Lord is my strength He makes my feet like those of a deer He makes me walk upon the heights For the choirmaster With stringed instruments
